one_liner: Ahrefs offers a broad REST API v3 with Bearer API keys, but real use requires a paid plan (Lite+, $129/mo); OAuth via Ahrefs Connect needs approval and an Enterprise plan for production; official remote MCP exists.
auth_notes: API v3 uses a Bearer API key created by workspace owners/admins (1-year lifetime). OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE exists via Ahrefs Connect, but requires app approval and Enterprise for production, so API key is the practical primary method.
access_notes: API is on eligible paid plans (Lite $129/mo and up). Free/Starter plans get only limited free test queries and free public endpoints (e.g. domain rating) with a free key.
blocker_notes: Users need a Lite+ paid plan for API units; OAuth (Ahrefs Connect) needs approval plus Enterprise for production. API-key-based toolkit is buildable, with each customer supplying their own key.

evidence.quote: Provide it in the Authorization header when making requests: `Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY`.
Ahrefs Connect uses **OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE)**.
Ahrefs API is available on [eligible paid plans](https://ahrefs.com/pricing). On all other plans, you'll still have access to a [limited set of free test queries]
Production access requires an Ahrefs Enterprise plan; development and testing are free.
Ahrefs provides a hosted MCP server that allows users with a Lite plan or higher to connect their Ahrefs account to supported AI tools.
